runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
The 180-day deadlines in OMB M-25-21 (the April 2025 memo) fall on two obligations.

**1. Develop an AI Strategy (CFO Act agencies only).** Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. The memo adds that agencies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

**2. Submit a compliance plan (all covered agencies).** Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. OMB has said it will provide templates for these compliance plans.

The memo's consolidated table also lists 180-day items, but the extracted text is garbled, so I can't confirm which actions they correspond to. The memo's other deadlines are 60 days (naming a Chief AI Officer) and 270 days (updating internal IT, data, cybersecurity, and privacy policies).
